qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Premium tire brand equity and specialized engineering know-how, but commodity passenger and commercial replacement tires face fierce price competition from low-cost Asian imports while auto OEMs squeeze margins, capping 5-year median GAAP ROIC at 11.1% (below the 12% hurdle).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Proof of Moat). Despite premium brand equity and specialty tire R&D, 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 11.1% fails the 12% hurdle (deteriorating to 9.8% in FY25). Structural price competition from low-cost Asian manufacturers in the replacement market and automotive OEM bargaining power prevent sustained pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: GAAP ROIC has steadily faded from 11.8% in 2022 to 11.6% in 2023, 10.6% in 2024, and 9.8% in 2025 (median 11.1%). Tangible ROIC slipped to 13.0% in FY25. Revenues contracted from €28.6B in FY22 to €26.0B in FY25, and Owner EPS fell from €2.79 to €2.34, failing peak-to-peak compounding.
